cohort: Two cohorts of women with type 1 insulin-dependent diabetes mellitus (TIDM): 333 pregnancies from the Diabetes in Pregnancy Program Project (1978-1993) and 358 pregnancies from the Consortium on Safe Labor (2002-2008)
finding: Normal-weight women with gestational weight gain within Institute of Medicine guidelines experienced a lower LGA prevalence.
birth_weight: Birth weight >90th percentile according to gestational age, race and sex
